# Environment

`cinnabar:extension/environment@0.1.0`

Local presentation only; no world mutation or outbound packets.

**Grants:** `environment` for weather and time; `fullbright` for lighting.

## Types

<a id="type-weather"></a>

### `weather`

Local visual weather target; none restores tracked server weather.

```wit
enum weather {
    clear,
    rain,
    thunder,
}
```

## Functions

<a id="set-weather-override"></a>

### `set-weather-override`

```wit
set-weather-override: func(value: option<weather>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Retains a local weather target after success; none resumes tracked server weather.

Types: [`weather`](environment.md#type-weather).

<a id="set-time-override"></a>

### `set-time-override`

```wit
set-time-override: func(ticks: option<u32>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Fixes visual time to 0–23999 ticks; none restores the tracked server clock.

<a id="set-fullbright"></a>

### `set-fullbright`

```wit
set-fullbright: func(enabled: bool) -> result<_, string>;
```

Retained local lighting override; requires the separate fullbright grant.
